measurement_method.carbon_intensity_source: NESO Carbon Intensity API (api.carbonintensity.org.uk), Great Britain national intensity, mean of monthly averages Nov 2025 - Oct 2026 = 121.7, rounded to 122 gCO2/kWh. Annual national average, not time-specific or regional. Same value as the group's shared measurement method.
measurement_method.carbon_intensity_range_source: Low: lowest NESO monthly national average in the same 12 months (Apr 2026). High: CodeCarbon bundled GBR annual intensity (237.589 g/kWh).
measurement_method.pue_source: Personal laptop, no data-centre cooling overhead.
measurement_method.cpu_power_source: Intel i5-13500H Processor Base Power 45 W (max turbo 95 W).
measurement_method.uncertainty_basis: CPU energy is estimated (no RAPL/Power Gadget counter on this Windows laptop), so the total is bracketed at 0.5x-2x, then x1.25 on the high side for unmetered motherboard, storage, fans, display and charger losses. Emission bounds combine this with the carbon-intensity range. Engineering assumptions, not statistical confidence intervals.
measurement_method.measurement_exclusions: Monitor, network equipment, lighting, embodied/manufacturing carbon, dataset download and report writing. Charger/battery conversion losses only in upper bound.
